text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I went to a family restaurant, I saw Wonder Acute looking troubled, surrounded by a massive amount of food.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
choice_data_list: That's an incredible amount of food, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, I tried to order... But they told me to order on something called a 'touch panel' or whatever...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I was just tapping the screen without really knowing what I was doing,
and then it ended up like this..."
choice_data_list: Why don't you explain the situation?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: No, no, it's not like I can't eat it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Everything looked so tasty,
I couldn't help touchin' the screen, y'see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's just, there's clearly way more food
than my usual meals, so I'm not quite sure what to do with it...
choice_data_list: In that case, want me to help?
If you want to eat it, go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, if you do that, then I can eat without holding back too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's split it in half and eat.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer-san.
Put your hands together, and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, I shared the food we had over-ordered
with Wonder Acute, and we enjoyed a delicious meal.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right.
That's what I was thinking when I touched it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I feel refreshed now.
I think I can eat all of this up and enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the great advice,
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, Wonder Acute enjoyed the family restaurant
to her heart's content.
